description: Adds the safe temp-workspace patch applier under scripts/repair/. SafePatchWorkspace stages a copy of the original repo under a caller-supplied temp_root, applies a list of FilePatch records (validated for path traversal, symlink escape, binary content, and per-file/total size), generates a unified diff between baseline and temp, and runs an injected verifier callable. On verifier failure (with rollback_on_failure=True) the temp tree is deleted. The original repo is treated as immutable: sha256 trees are taken before and after every call, and any divergence flips the status to SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED. No subprocess. No network. No real toolchain invocation in this rung — the verifier is a callable; the real BuildAdapter-backed verifier is wired in VERIFIED_REPAIR_TRACE_LOCK_001.
purpose: Rung 3 of the verified-repair campaign. Gives the apparatus a bounded surface for *applying* a candidate patch without ever touching the user's repo. Sets up VERIFIED_REPAIR_TRACE_LOCK_001 to compose a real verifier on top, and HUMAN_APPROVAL_SOURCE_MUTATION_GATE_LOCK_001 to gate the eventual original-repo write.
skip_rationale: Two symlink-escape tests skip on hosts where os.symlink is unavailable (Windows without Developer Mode / admin). Same skip pattern as workspace-escape tests under tests/security/.

guards.path_traversal: Rejected: '../*', absolute paths ('/etc/*'), drive-anchored paths ('C:/*'), empty, and '..'-containing segments.
guards.symlink_target_blocked: If the target file exists as a symlink, refuse with PATCH_BLOCKED_SYMLINK_ESCAPE.
guards.symlink_escape_via_parent: If the resolved target path falls outside the temp workspace, refuse.
guards.binary_content: Content containing NUL bytes is rejected with PATCH_BLOCKED_BINARY_CONTENT.
guards.total_size_cap: 16_000_000 bytes across all patches; over → PATCH_REJECTED.

invariants: SafePatchWorkspace.apply_and_verify NEVER writes to the original repo. The original's sha256 tree before == after on every code path; SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED is set if not.
All writes go to ``<temp_root>/safe_patch_<workspace_id>/``; the resolve check refuses any path that escapes the temp dir.
A baseline snapshot under ``<temp_root>/safe_patch_<workspace_id>__BASELINE_/`` is created at stage time and used to compute the unified diff after apply.
rollback() deletes both temp and baseline; it is idempotent.
Path traversal segments ('..', empty), absolute paths, and drive-anchored paths are rejected with PATCH_BLOCKED_PATH_ESCAPE.
A patch whose target is a symlink (or whose target resolves outside the temp workspace) is rejected with PATCH_BLOCKED_SYMLINK_ESCAPE.
Patches whose new_content contains a NUL byte are rejected with PATCH_BLOCKED_BINARY_CONTENT.
The injected verifier callable receives only the temp workspace path; it cannot reach the original.
Verifier failure with rollback_on_failure=True deletes the temp tree and sets status=PATCH_ROLLED_BACK.
training_eligible is False on every SafePatchResult.
scripts/repair/safe_patch_workspace.py and scripts/repair/safe_patch_record.py contain no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
Audit path-rule for safe_patch_* is LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY (overrides the generic scripts/repair/ MUST_MIGRATE classification).
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
files_modified: scripts/dev/parallel_execution_layer_audit.py (added LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY rule for scripts/repair/safe_patch_*; placed before the generic repair-pipeline rule)
remaining_gaps: No real toolchain verifier is wired in this rung. VERIFIED_REPAIR_TRACE_LOCK_001 composes a BuildAdapter-backed verifier through intake.hardened_runner.
The unified diff is computed by file replacement (not hunk-level patch application). Future rungs may add a hunk-level applier if needed.
Per-file (2 MB) and total (16 MB) byte caps are reasonable defaults; a future rung may surface them through determinex_settings.
